sentences.c: 豫章故郡，洪都新府。
sentences.m: 这里是汉代的豫章旧郡，如今是洪州的新府。
sentences.e: This was the old commandery of Yuzhang, and is now the new prefecture of Hongdu.

sentences.c: 星分翼轸，地接衡庐。
sentences.m: 在天上属于翼宿、轸宿的分野，在地上连接着衡山和庐山。
sentences.e: By the stars it falls in the division of Yi and Zhen; by the land it joins Mount Heng and Mount Lu.

sentences.c: 襟三江而带五湖，控蛮荆而引瓯越。
sentences.m: 以三江为衣襟，以五湖为衣带，控制着荆楚，连接着瓯越。
sentences.e: It takes the three rivers as its collar and the five lakes as its belt, holding the southern marches in check and drawing the Ou and Yue lands after it.

sentences.c: 物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟；人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻。
sentences.m: 物产的精华化作天上的宝气，宝剑的光华直射到牛宿、斗宿之间；人才杰出、地有灵气，徐孺子曾使陈蕃为他放下卧榻。
sentences.e: Here the finest of things became heavenly treasure, and a sword's radiance shot up to the space between the Ox and the Dipper; here outstanding men met a gifted land, and Xu Ru once caused Chen Fan to lower his own couch for him.

sentences.c: 雄州雾列，俊采星驰。
sentences.m: 雄伟的州城像雾一样铺展开来，杰出的人才像流星一样奔驰。
sentences.e: The grand city spreads out like mist, and men of talent speed past like shooting stars.

sentences.c: 台隍枕夷夏之交，宾主尽东南之美。
sentences.m: 城郭依傍在中原与南方的交界处，宾客和主人都是东南一带的俊杰。
sentences.e: The walls rest where the Chinese lands meet the southern wilds, and hosts and guests alike are the finest of the southeast.

sentences.c: 都督阎公之雅望，棨戟遥临；宇文新州之懿范，襜帷暂驻。
sentences.m: 都督阎公有崇高的声望，仪仗从远方赶来；新州刺史宇文氏有美好的风范，车驾在此暂时停留。
sentences.e: Governor Yan, of lofty reputation, has come from afar with his ceremonial halberds; the new prefect Yuwen, a model of virtue, has halted his carriage curtains here a while.

sentences.c: 十旬休假，胜友如云；千里逢迎，高朋满座。
sentences.m: 正逢十日一休的假期，好友如云般聚集；远道千里前来迎接，尊贵的宾客坐满席位。
sentences.e: It is the ten-day holiday, and good friends gather like clouds; greeted from a thousand li away, honored guests fill the seats.

sentences.c: 腾蛟起凤，孟学士之词宗；紫电清霜，王将军之武库。
sentences.m: 文采如蛟龙腾空、凤凰飞起，是孟学士这样的文章宗师；兵器如紫电、青霜，出自王将军的武库。
sentences.e: Rising like a dragon and soaring like a phoenix — such is the literary mastery of Academician Meng; purple lightning and clear frost — such are the arms in General Wang's arsenal.

sentences.c: 家君作宰，路出名区；童子何知，躬逢胜饯。
sentences.m: 家父在做县令，我因路过这有名的地方；小孩子懂得什么，竟亲身遇上这场盛大的宴会。
sentences.e: My father serves as a county magistrate, and my road has brought me through this famous place; what does a boy know, that he should attend such a splendid feast?

sentences.c: 时维九月，序属三秋。
sentences.m: 时令正是九月，季节属于深秋。
sentences.e: The time is the ninth month, and the season is the third month of autumn.

sentences.c: 潦水尽而寒潭清，烟光凝而暮山紫。
sentences.m: 积水退尽，寒潭清澈，烟霭凝聚，暮山呈现紫色。
sentences.e: The pools have drained and the cold ponds run clear; the mist gathers and the evening hills turn purple.

sentences.c: 俨骖騑于上路，访风景于崇阿；临帝子之长洲，得天人之旧馆。
sentences.m: 驾着车马在高高的路上前行，到高山之下去寻访风景；来到滕王曾游的长洲，见到当年如天上神仙般的旧馆。
sentences.e: With horses harnessed we take the high road and seek out scenery among the lofty hills; we come to the long isle of the imperial prince and reach the old lodge of that heaven-sent man.

sentences.c: 层峦耸翠，上出重霄；飞阁流丹，下临无地。
sentences.m: 层层山峦耸立着青翠之色，向上直插云霄；凌空的楼阁涂着鲜艳的红色，向下俯视看不到地面。
sentences.e: Layer upon layer the ridges rise in green, thrusting up into the high heavens; the soaring pavilion runs with red, looking down on groundless space.

sentences.c: 鹤汀凫渚，穷岛屿之萦回；桂殿兰宫，即冈峦之体势。
sentences.m: 白鹤栖息的沙洲、野鸭聚集的小渚，穷尽了岛屿曲折回环的景致；桂木兰木装饰的殿堂宫室，依着山冈的形势而建。
sentences.e: Sandbars where cranes rest and islets where ducks gather exhaust every winding turn of the islands; halls of cassia and palaces of orchid follow the lie of the ridges.

sentences.c: 披绣闼，俯雕甍，山原旷其盈视，川泽纡其骇瞩。
sentences.m: 推开雕花的阁门，俯视雕饰的屋脊，山岭平原辽阔得满眼皆是，江河湖泽曲折得令人惊叹。
sentences.e: Pushing open the carved doors and looking down over the painted ridgepoles, the hills and plains stretch wide to fill the eye, and the rivers and marshes wind away astonishingly.

sentences.c: 闾阎扑地，钟鸣鼎食之家；舸舰弥津，青雀黄龙之舳。
sentences.m: 民居遍地，尽是鸣钟列鼎而食的富贵人家；船只布满渡口，船头画着青雀黄龙。
sentences.e: Houses crowd the ground, homes of families that dine to the sound of bells; boats fill the ferry, their prows painted with blue sparrows and yellow dragons.

sentences.c: 云销雨霁，彩彻区明。
sentences.m: 云消雨停，阳光普照，天空明净。
sentences.e: The clouds scatter and the rain clears, and light shines through a bright sky.

sentences.c: 落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色。
sentences.m: 晚霞与孤独的野鸭一同飞翔，秋天的江水与辽阔的天空浑然一色。
sentences.e: The falling clouds fly with a lone duck, and the autumn water is one color with the vast sky.

sentences.c: 渔舟唱晚，响穷彭蠡之滨；雁阵惊寒，声断衡阳之浦。
sentences.m: 渔船傍晚唱起歌来，歌声响彻彭蠡湖边；雁群被寒气惊起而鸣叫，叫声消失在衡阳的水边。
sentences.e: Fishing boats sing at evening, and the sound carries to the shores of Poyang; the wild geese, startled by the cold, fall silent at the banks of Hengyang.

sentences.c: 遥襟甫畅，逸兴遄飞。
sentences.m: 远望的胸怀刚刚舒畅，超逸的兴致便迅速飞扬。
sentences.e: My far-ranging heart has just opened, and soaring thoughts fly up at once.

sentences.c: 爽籁发而清风生，纤歌凝而白云遏。
sentences.m: 排箫响起，清风随之而生；细密的歌声凝聚不散，行云也被阻住。
sentences.e: The pipes sound and a clear wind rises; the delicate song hangs in the air and the white clouds are held back.

sentences.c: 睢园绿竹，气凌彭泽之樽；邺水朱华，光照临川之笔。
sentences.m: 这里宴饮的气派胜过睢园绿竹之会、彭泽之樽的酒量；文采的光华超过邺水朱华之作、临川之笔。
sentences.e: The spirit here outdoes the green bamboo of Suiyuan and the wine cups of Pengze; the brilliance here outshines the red blossoms by the Ye river and the brush of Linchuan.

sentences.c: 四美具，二难并。
sentences.m: 良辰、美景、赏心、乐事四样都齐备，贤主、嘉宾两种难得的人都聚在一起。
sentences.e: The four excellences are all present, and the two rare things meet together.

sentences.c: 穷睇眄于中天，极娱游于暇日。
sentences.m: 极目远望半空中的景象，在这闲暇的日子里尽情游乐。
sentences.e: We gaze to the limit of the mid-sky, and exhaust the pleasures of this leisure day.

sentences.c: 天高地迥，觉宇宙之无穷；兴尽悲来，识盈虚之有数。
sentences.m: 天高远、地辽阔，感到宇宙无穷无尽；兴致尽了悲从中来，知道事物的盛衰消长自有定数。
sentences.e: Sky is high and earth far, and one feels the universe has no end; when joy is spent sorrow comes, and one knows that fullness and emptiness have their measure.

sentences.c: 望长安于日下，目吴会于云间。
sentences.m: 遥望夕阳下的长安，远看云间的吴会。
sentences.e: I look toward Chang'an beneath the sun, and gaze at Wu and Kuaiji among the clouds.

sentences.c: 地势极而南溟深，天柱高而北辰远。
sentences.m: 大地的尽头是深邃的南海，天柱高耸而北极星遥远。
sentences.e: The land ends where the southern sea lies deep, and the pillar of heaven stands high while the pole star is far.

sentences.c: 关山难越，谁悲失路之人？
sentences.m: 关山重重难以越过，谁来怜悯迷失道路的人？
sentences.e: Passes and mountains are hard to cross — who pities the man who has lost his way?

sentences.c: 萍水相逢，尽是他乡之客。
sentences.m: 像浮萍随水相逢，都是异乡的客人。
sentences.e: Meeting like duckweed on the water, we are all strangers from other lands.

sentences.c: 怀帝阍而不见，奉宣室以何年？
sentences.m: 怀念朝廷却见不到天子，什么时候才能像贾谊那样被召入宣室？
sentences.e: I long for the palace gate but cannot see it; in what year shall I be summoned to the Xuan Chamber?

sentences.c: 嗟乎！时运不齐，命途多舛。
sentences.m: 唉！时运不好，命运多有不顺。
sentences.e: Alas! Fortune is uneven, and the road of life is full of turns.

sentences.c: 冯唐易老，李广难封。
sentences.m: 冯唐容易老去，李广难以封侯。
sentences.e: Feng Tang grew old so easily; Li Guang could never be enfeoffed.

sentences.c: 屈贾谊于长沙，非无圣主；窜梁鸿于海曲，岂乏明时？
sentences.m: 使贾谊屈居于长沙，并不是没有圣明的君主；使梁鸿逃隐到海边，难道缺乏清明的时代？
sentences.e: That Jia Yi was kept down in Changsha did not mean there was no sage ruler; that Liang Hong fled to the seaside did not mean the age lacked enlightenment.

sentences.c: 所赖君子见机，达人知命。
sentences.m: 所依靠的是君子能看清时机，通达的人懂得天命。
sentences.e: What we rely on is that the noble man sees the moment, and the wise man knows fate.

sentences.c: 老当益壮，宁移白首之心？穷且益坚，不坠青云之志。
sentences.m: 年老应当更加壮盛，怎能改变白头时的志向？处境艰难应当更加坚定，不放弃凌云的志向。
sentences.e: In age one should be stronger still — how could a white-haired heart be changed? In hardship one should be firmer yet, and never let the cloud-high ambition fall.

sentences.c: 酌贪泉而觉爽，处涸辙以犹欢。
sentences.m: 喝了贪泉的水反而觉得清爽，处在干涸的车辙里依然欢乐。
sentences.e: Drinking from the spring of greed, one still feels clean; lying in a dried-out wheel rut, one is still glad.

sentences.c: 北海虽赊，扶摇可接；东隅已逝，桑榆非晚。
sentences.m: 北海虽然遥远，乘着旋风仍可到达；早晨的时光已经逝去，傍晚的时光还不算晚。
sentences.e: Though the Northern Sea is far, the whirlwind can reach it; the eastern morning is gone, but the mulberry and elm at sunset are not too late.

sentences.c: 孟尝高洁，空余报国之情；阮籍猖狂，岂效穷途之哭！
sentences.m: 孟尝品行高洁，只留下报国的情怀；阮籍放纵不羁，怎能学他走到路的尽头就痛哭！
sentences.e: Meng Chang was pure and lofty, yet left only a heart that could not serve its country; Ruan Ji was wild and unrestrained — would I imitate him and weep when the road runs out!

sentences.c: 勃，三尺微命，一介书生。
sentences.m: 我王勃，是地位卑微的一个书生。
sentences.e: I, Bo, am a man of small stature and small lot, a mere scholar.

sentences.c: 无路请缨，等终军之弱冠；有怀投笔，慕宗悫之长风。
sentences.m: 没有门路请求杀敌报国，年纪却与终军请缨时相同；心怀投笔从戎的志向，仰慕宗悫乘长风破万里浪的豪情。
sentences.e: I have no way to ask for the commander's cord as Zhong Jun did at twenty; I cherish the wish to throw down the brush, and admire Zong Que's long wind.

sentences.c: 舍簪笏于百龄，奉晨昏于万里。
sentences.m: 舍弃一生的功名仕途，到万里之外去侍奉父亲的早晚起居。
sentences.e: I give up cap and tablet for a lifetime, and go ten thousand li to tend my father morning and evening.

sentences.c: 非谢家之宝树，接孟氏之芳邻。
sentences.m: 我不是谢家那样的宝树，却有幸结交孟氏那样的好邻居。
sentences.e: I am no precious tree of the Xie family, yet I have come among good neighbors like the Mengs.

sentences.c: 他日趋庭，叨陪鲤对；今兹捧袂，喜托龙门。
sentences.m: 将来有机会到父亲面前聆听教诲，像孔鲤那样趋庭受训；今天举起衣袖拜见，高兴地托身龙门。
sentences.e: Another day I shall hasten across the courtyard and sit at my father's side as Li did; today I lift my sleeves in salute, glad to shelter at the Dragon Gate.

sentences.c: 杨意不逢，抚凌云而自惜；钟期既遇，奏流水以何惭？
sentences.m: 没遇到杨得意那样的举荐人，只能抚着《凌云赋》自我惋惜；既然遇到了钟子期那样的知音，弹一曲《流水》又有什么可羞愧的？
sentences.e: Had I met no Yang Yide, I could only stroke my "Soaring Clouds" and regret; but since I have met a Zhong Ziqi, why should I be ashamed to play "Flowing Water"?

sentences.c: 呜呼！胜地不常，盛筵难再；兰亭已矣，梓泽丘墟。
sentences.m: 唉！美好的地方不会常在，盛大的宴会难以再有；兰亭的盛会已经过去，梓泽也成了废墟。
sentences.e: Alas! Fair places do not last, and great feasts cannot come twice; the Orchid Pavilion is gone, and Zize is a heap of ruins.

sentences.c: 临别赠言，幸承恩于伟饯；登高作赋，是所望于群公。
sentences.m: 临别时赠几句话，有幸承蒙这场盛大饯宴的恩情；登高作赋，就寄望于诸位了。
sentences.e: At parting I offer these words, honored to receive the grace of this great farewell feast; to climb high and compose a poem — that I look for from you all.

sentences.c: 敢竭鄙怀，恭疏短引；一言均赋，四韵俱成。
sentences.m: 我冒昧地倾尽浅陋的心意，恭敬地写下这篇短序；请每人各写一首诗，四韵都已写成。
sentences.e: I venture to pour out my poor feelings and respectfully set down this short preface; let each of you write a verse, and the four rhymes are done.

sentences.c: 请洒潘江，各倾陆海云尔。
sentences.m: 请各位挥洒潘岳那样的文采，倾泻陆机那样的才华吧。
sentences.e: Pray pour out your Pan River and empty your Lu Sea, each one of you.
